newsitem.title: USA: Saliva Diagnostic can sell test in India.
newsitem.headline: Saliva Diagnostic can sell test in India.

text.p: Saliva Diagnostic Systems Inc said Wednesday it received regulatory approval in India to market and distribute its rapid HIV testing product in that country.
The company said it expects that more than 350,000 Sero*Strip HIV tests will be used in its first year of distribution in India.

The Sero*Strip HIV rapid HIV test uses a very small of amount of serum or plasma to detect HIV antibodies. The test takes less than a minute to conduct and produces results in five to 15 minutes. The test does not need automated equipment or refrigerated storage.
The World Health Organization (WHO) has estimated that by the year 2000, about five million people in India could be infected by the HIV virus.

Initial production of Sero*Strip HIV will begin at the company's facility in Singapore. Manufacturing is expected to move into India to reduce operating costs, the company said. The products will be distributed by Fremont Novo Sciences, based in Chicago and Merind Ltd, a unit of the Tata Group in India.
